correctness.rationale: Exact field F64 implemented as F2[u]/(u^6+u+1), whose irreducibility is exhaustively checked. The plane cubic is smooth from partial derivatives and has 81 enumerated rational points. The program enumerates all 4161 rational plane points, all rational three-secant lines from unordered pairs, and all 4096 nonvertical plus 65 other lines; a second independent root-count method exactly matches N(P) for each of the 4161 centers, not merely totals. All six exterior strata and equality of the maximum locus to the 12 F4-subplane exterior points are checked pointwise. Counts are finite and exhaustive; no extrapolation.

originality.rationale: The complete per-center split-fiber distribution (six values and six multiplicities) and the exact 12-center F4-subplane maximizer equality are finer than established global completeness and line intersection characters. Inspected primary literature does not state this per-center refinement; close semantic index records address other objects, not the Hermitian cubic over F64. Search nonappearance is not uniqueness proof, and an old unindexed finer incidence table remains an explicit risk.
residual_risks: A fine-point incidence/three-secant valency distribution for the very same cubic could exist in a presently unindexed older finite-geometry table or code archive.
The finite field result is specific and does not prove a uniform general formula across extension degrees or a geometric decomposition of all lower-valency loci.

value.rationale: Completely split fibers of projections from all exterior rational points are a natural arithmetic problem for degree-three maps of smooth genus-one plane cubics. The six-stratum spectrum and the exact subfield-geometric description of the 12 unusual maximizers refine and strictly strengthen the known completeness and line-character counts; this is a motivated full classification of center-by-center splitting over a finite field, not a single accidental count.
